jobs.title: Head Fraud Services (100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Fraud Services (100%)

Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Reference 8286

Möchtest du die Sicherheit im Kartengeschäft aktiv mitgestalten und zwei Teams führen, die Betrugsfälle bearbeiten sowie Fraud-Risiken frühzeitig erkennen und wirksam begrenzen? Dann übernimm die Leitung unserer Teams Fraud Services (Monitoring) und Fraud Intelligence.

Als Head Fraud Services verantwortest du die fachliche und personelle Führung der Teams Fraud Services (Monitoring)  und Fraud Intelligence. Du stellst einen zuverlässigen operativen Betrieb sicher, steuerst die Weiterentwicklung der Fraud Detection und Prevention und förderst die Zusammenarbeit mit internen sowie externen Partnern.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Fachliche und personelle Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung der Teams Fraud Services und Fraud Intelligence

• Sicherstellung des operativen Fraud Monitorings, der Bearbeitung von Betrugsverdachtsfällen und des Fraud Incident Managements

• Steuerung der Analyse neuer Fraud-Trends sowie der Definition, Priorisierung und Wirksamkeitsmessung geeigneter Gegenmassnahmen

• Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung des Rule Managements, der Fraud Prevention Prozesse sowie der relevanten Reports und KPIs

• Zusammenarbeit mit Banken, Schemes, Behörden sowie internen und externen Partnern und Vertretung des Bereichs in relevanten Gremien

• Fraud Incident Management bei Fraud Attacken

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder höhere Weiterbildung mit ausgewiesener Berufserfahrung im Finanz- oder Kartengeschäft

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Fraud Management, vorzugsweise im Bereich Debitkarten und TWINT.

• Führungserfahrung sowie die Fähigkeit, Teams zielorientiert zu entwickeln und Veränderungen wirksam umzusetzen

• Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten verbunden mit einer strukturierten, qualitätsorientierten Arbeitsweise

• Klare und professionelle Kommunikation sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Messaging Platform Engineer, Cloud & Containers
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Messaging Platform Engineer, Cloud & Containers

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8165

We are looking for a hands-on Messaging Platform Engineer to join our team in Zürich. A core responsibility of this role is the ongoing operation, maintenance and development of our business-critical on-premises IBM MQ Appliance environment. Alongside this established platform, our next step is to expand our messaging portfolio across OpenShift and Microsoft Azure. Beyond IBM MQ, we are also evaluating complementary cloud-native messaging technologies for the future hybrid messaging portfolio. This role combines platform engineering with software development. Your experience does not need to be limited to IBM MQ.

What You Will Do

• Operate and improve the IBM MQ Appliance platform

• Build automation, self-service capabilities and platform services

• Design and implement IBM MQ services in OpenShift and Azure

• Evaluate complementary messaging technologies

• Develop automation using APIs, CI/CD and infrastructure as code

• Troubleshoot production issues and participate in on-call rotation

What You Bring

• Enterprise messaging platform administration or engineering experience

• Production experience in OpenShift or public cloud environments

• Automation or software engineering skills in Java and Spring Boot

• Strong Linux, container, networking and security fundamentals

• Experience with CI/CD, observability and incident management

• Knowledge of Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform or cloud-native messaging

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8237

Are you passionate about secure web access, identity, and modern authentication technologies? Then our Web Access Management team wants to hear from you. We are a collaborative and security-focused team responsible for protecting access to business-critical web applications and APIs. Our goal is to provide stable, secure, and continuously improving access services across reverse proxy, web application firewall, and customer identity platforms. In this role, you will work closely with application teams, security architects, platform engineers, and service owners to design, operate, and enhance secure access patterns in a regulated environment.

What You Will Do

• Operate and enhance Web Access Management services, including reverse proxy, access gateway, web application firewall, and customer identity components.

• Design, build, and troubleshoot secure authentication and single sign-on flows based on OpenID Connect, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0.

• Configure routing, TLS certificates, access policies, authorization mappings, and upstream integrations for web applications and APIs.

• Tune and maintain web application firewall policies, including OWASP Core Rule Set handling, exceptions, anomaly scoring, and change control.

• Contribute to operational stability, automation, monitoring, incident response, upgrades, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous service improvement.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on knowledge of reverse proxy or access gateway platforms, including TLS handling, routing, header and cookie management, session handling, and high-availability operations.

• Practical experience with web application firewall technologies, ModSecurity, OWASP Core Rule Set, rule tuning, false-positive handling, and secure publishing patterns.

• Solid understanding of customer identity and access management, identity lifecycle, multi-factor authentication, secure account recovery, token validation, and authorization models.

• Good knowledge of federation and access protocols such as OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SAML 2.0, JWT, PKCE, scopes, claims, certificates, metadata, and key rotation.

• Analytical, security-minded, and collaborative working style, with good communication skills; fluent English is required, German is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Senior Application Engineer

Zurich |  Working from home up to to 40% possible | Referenz 8309

Du arbeitest gerne in einem dynamischen Team und agilen Umfeld und Prozessautomatisierung ist deine Stärke? Dann werde Senior Application Engineer bei Terravis und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir intelligente, skalierbare Lösungen entwickeln. Als führende digitale Plattform setzt Terravis Massstäbe in der domänenübergreifenden digitalen Abwicklung von Grundstückgeschäften und vernetzt Finanzindustrie, Notariats- und Grundbuchwesen für sichere, effiziente und rechtskonforme Immobilienprozesse. In deiner Rolle als Senior Application Engineer trägst du massgeblich dazu bei, Arbeitsabläufe zu digitalisieren und End-to-End-Prozesse zu optimieren. So hilfst du, den Papieraufwand zu reduzieren, Transaktionen zu beschleunigen und die Zusammenarbeit im Schweizer Immobilien-Ökosystem nachhaltig zu stärken.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Design, develop, and maintain skalierbarer BPMN- und BPEL-basierter Prozessabläufe

• Zusammenarbeit mit Domain Ownern zur Erfassung und Analyse von Geschäftsanforderungen

• Implementierung und Optimierung von Lösungen mit der ActiveVOS Workflow Engine

• Sicherstellung von Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit in allen entwickelten Lösungen

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung und 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Java-Anwendungen wie z.B.: Java, XML/JAXB, Spring, XQuery

• Erfahrung in der praktischen Anwendung von BPMN und BPEL.

• Expertise in mindestens einer Workflow/Prozess-Engine (z.B. ActiveVOS, Camunda, Flowable)

• Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Deutsch und Englisch; Fähigkeit zur effektiven Kommunikation mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern

• Erfahrung mit der Integration von BPM-Engines in Microservice- oder Unternehmensarchitekturen ist ein Plus

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Julia Schmidt  unter der Nummer +41583998670.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Ingegnere di applicazioni senior

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8309

Ti piace lavorare in un team dinamico e ambiente agile e l'automazione dei processi è la tua forza? Diventa poi un Senior Application Engineer di Terravis e forma attivamente come sviluppiamo soluzioni intelligenti e scalabili. Come piattaforma digitale leader, Terravis stabilisce gli standard nel trattamento digitale cross-domain delle transazioni immobiliari e reti l'industria finanziaria, notai e registri di terra per processi immobiliari sicuri, efficienti e legalmente conformi. Nel tuo ruolo di Senior Application Engineer, contribuisci significativamente alla digitalizzazione dei flussi di lavoro e all'ottimizzazione dei processi end-to-end. Ciò contribuisce a ridurre le scartoffie, accelerare le transazioni e rafforzare in modo sostenibile la cooperazione nell'ecosistema immobiliare svizzero.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Progettazione, sviluppo e mantenimento dei flussi di processo scalabili basati su BPMN e BPEL

• Collabora con i proprietari di domini per catturare e analizzare le esigenze aziendali

• Attuazione e ottimizzazione delle soluzioni con ActiveVOS Workflow Engine

• Garantire prestazioni, affidabilità e sicurezza in tutte le soluzioni sviluppate

Lo porti con te.

• Completato l'educazione informatica e 10+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni Java come: Java, XML/JAXB, Spring, XQuery

• Esperienza nell'applicazione pratica di BPMN e BPEL.

• Competenza in almeno un flusso di lavoro/motore di processo (ad esempio ActiveVOS, Camunda, Flowable)

• competenze linguistiche in parola e scrittura; tedesco e inglese; capacità di comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici

• L'esperienza nell'integrazione dei motori BPM in architetture microservice o enterprise è un vantaggio

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Mateusz Kozielec su +41583998611.

Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Specialist Fraud Analyst (100%)

Zurich |  Bis zu 40 % Home Office möglich | Reference 8287

Bist du breit mit uns das Vertrauen im Kartengeschäft zu stärken, in dem wir gemeinsam betrügerische Aktivitäten aufdecken und wirksam stoppen? Dann verstärke unser Fraud Intelligence Team.

Als Fraud Analyst bist du für die Analyse von betrügerischen Transaktionen verantwortlich und entwickelst gezielte Gegenmassnahmen um Betrugsaktivitäten zu unterbinden.

• Steuerung Fraud Detection & Prevention (PRISMA)

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Erkennung neuer Betrugsmuster und Angriffsszenarien.

• Erfahrung im Aufbau, der Optimierung und dem Testing von Fraud-Detection-Regeln und Scoring-Modellen.

• Sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Python für Datenanalysen und Automatisierungen.

• Fähigkeit, grosse Datenmengen auszuwerten und daraus konkrete Fraud- und Business-Massnahmen abzuleiten.

• Erfahrung mit Fraud-Management-, Case-Management- und Reporting-Plattformen.

• Fundiertes Know-how im Fraud Management und Interesse an innovativen Ansätzen in den Bereichen Analytics, Detection und Prevention

jobs.description:

Internship Tax Services

Olten |  100% | Referenz 8204

SIX Securities Services nimmt als zentrale Verwahrstelle für Wertschriften in der Schweiz eine wichtige Rolle im Finanzmarkt ein und unterliegt deshalb zahlreichen regulatorischen Anforderungen – insbesondere im Steuerbereich. Um diesen Anforderungen sowie den stetig wachsenden Kundenbedürfnissen gerecht zu werden und gezielt Nachwuchstalente zu fördern, bieten wir ein einjähriges Internship im Bereich Tax Services an.

Während des Internships erhältst du einen umfassenden Einblick in die steuerlichen Aspekte des Wertschriftengeschäfts. Du lernst die wichtigsten Steuerarten im Wertschriftenbereich kennen, unterstützt bei der Depotdokumentation und Kontoeröffnung entlang der Verwahrkette und wirkst bei der Bearbeitung von Steuerrückforderungen in verschiedenen Märkten mit.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du übernimmst die risikoarme und kundenorientierte Abwicklung des Tagesgeschäfts im Team Regulatory Tax mit Fokus auf US Tax, Transaction Based Taxes sowie Account Documentation.

• Im Team Tax Processing Services lernst du, Steuerrückforderungsdienstleistungen für verschiedene internationale Märkte selbstständig abzuwickeln.

• Du unterstützt bei operativen, administrativen und analytischen Tätigkeiten sowie bei steuerrelevanten Projekten und Publikationen.

• Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen eigenverantwortlich und führst fachliche Abklärungen mit Depotbanken, Steuerbehörden und weiteren externen Gegenparteien durch.

• Du arbeitest aktiv an anspruchsvolleren steuerlichen Fragestellungen mit und baust dein Fachwissen kontinuierlich aus.

Das brings du mit

• Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsrecht, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

• Erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Daten sowie in der Datenanalyse sind von Vorteil.

• Du bist eine teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit Eigeninitiative und überzeugenden Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, eine strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere in Excel und PowerPoint.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Tirocinio Tax Services

Olten | 100% | Riferimento 8204

SIX Securities Services, in qualità di depositaria centrale di titoli in Svizzera, svolge un ruolo importante nel mercato finanziario ed è pertanto soggetta a numerosi requisiti normativi, in particolare in ambito fiscale. Per soddisfare tali requisiti e le esigenze sempre crescenti della clientela, nonché per promuovere in modo mirato i giovani talenti, offriamo un tirocinio della durata di un anno nell'area Tax Services.

Durante il tirocinio avrai una panoramica completa degli aspetti fiscali delle operazioni in titoli. Imparerai a conoscere le principali tipologie di imposte nell'ambito dei titoli, fornirai supporto nella documentazione dei depositi e nell'apertura dei conti lungo la catena di custodia e collaborerai alla gestione delle richieste di rimborso fiscale in diversi mercati.

Queste sono le tue mansioni

- Ti occuperai della gestione a basso rischio e orientata al cliente delle attività quotidiane nel team Regulatory Tax, con particolare attenzione a US Tax, Transaction Based Taxes e Account Documentation.
- Nel team Tax Processing Services imparerai a gestire autonomamente i servizi di richiesta di rimborso fiscale per vari mercati internazionali.
- Fornirai supporto nelle attività operative, amministrative e analitiche, nonché nei progetti e nelle pubblicazioni pertinenti sotto il profilo fiscale.
- Gestirai in autonomia le richieste dei clienti e svolgerai approfondimenti tecnici con banche depositarie, autorità fiscali e altre controparti esterne.
- Collaborerai attivamente alla gestione di questioni fiscali più complesse e amplierai costantemente le tue conoscenze specialistiche.

Cosa porti con te

- Bachelor conseguito in economia aziendale, diritto economico, informatica gestionale o disciplina affine.
- Una prima esperienza nella gestione e nell'analisi dei dati costituisce un vantaggio.
- Sei una persona orientata al lavoro di squadra, dotata di spirito d'iniziativa e di ottime capacità comunicative.
- Possiedi spiccate capacità analitiche e concettuali, un metodo di lavoro strutturato e autonomo, nonché un'ottima conoscenza di MS-Office, in particolare di Excel e PowerPoint.
- Ottima padronanza del tedesco e dell'inglese, sia orale sia scritta.

Contatti

In caso di domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Janine Reichling al numero +41 58 399 42 99.

Per questa posizione prendiamo in considerazione esclusivamente candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi; saremo pertanto lieti di ricevere candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.

Description

SIX is driving the transformation of the financial markets forward.

What sets us apart drives us forward: Between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and the future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of the financial markets with us.

Internship Tax Services

Olten | 100% | Reference 8204

As the central securities depository for securities in Switzerland, SIX Securities Services plays an important role in the financial market and is therefore subject to numerous regulatory requirements – particularly in the area of taxation. To meet these requirements and the steadily growing needs of our clients, and to specifically promote young talent, we offer a one-year internship in Tax Services.

During the internship, you will gain comprehensive insight into the tax aspects of the securities business. You will learn about the most important types of tax in the securities sector, support securities account documentation and account opening along the custody chain, and assist with processing tax reclaims in various markets.

Your responsibilities

- You will handle the low-risk, client-oriented processing of day-to-day business in the Regulatory Tax team, with a focus on US Tax, Transaction Based Taxes and Account Documentation.
- In the Tax Processing Services team, you will learn to independently process tax reclaim services for various international markets.
- You will support operational, administrative and analytical activities as well as tax-related projects and publications.
- You will handle client inquiries independently and conduct subject-matter clarifications with custodian banks, tax authorities and other external counterparties.
- You will actively contribute to more challenging tax-related matters and continuously expand your expertise.

What you bring

- Completed bachelor's degree in business administration, business law, business information systems or a comparable field.
- Initial experience working with data and in data analysis is an advantage.
- You are a team-oriented personality with initiative and convincing communication skills.
- You have strong analytical and conceptual skills, a structured and independent way of working, and very good MS Office skills, particularly in Excel and PowerPoint.
- Very good command of German and English, both written and spoken.

Contact

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Janine Reichling at +41 58 399 42 99.

For this vacancy, we will consider direct applications only.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

Afin de satisfaire à ces exigences ainsi qu’aux besoins toujours croissants de nos clients et de soutenir de manière ciblée les jeunes talents, nous proposons un stage d’un an dans le domaine de Tax Services.

Pendant le stage, tu acquerras une vue d’ensemble des aspects fiscaux des opérations sur titres. Tu te familiariseras avec les principaux types d’impôts dans le domaine des titres, tu apporteras ton soutien à la documentation des dépôts et à l’ouverture de comptes tout au long de la chaîne de conservation, et tu contribueras au traitement des demandes de remboursement d’impôts sur différents marchés.

Voici tes tâches

- Tu prends en charge le traitement quotidien à faible risque et orienté client au sein de l’équipe Regulatory Tax, avec un accent sur US Tax, Transaction Based Taxes ainsi que Account Documentation.
- Au sein de l’équipe Tax Processing Services, tu apprends à traiter de manière autonome des services de récupération fiscale pour différents marchés internationaux.
- Tu apportes ton soutien à des activités opérationnelles, administratives et analytiques ainsi qu’à des projets et publications liés à la fiscalité.
- Tu traites de manière autonome les demandes des clients et procèdes à des clarifications techniques avec des banques dépositaires, des autorités fiscales et d’autres contreparties externes.
- Tu participes activement à des problématiques fiscales plus complexes et développes continuellement tes connaissances spécialisées.

Ce que tu apportes

- Diplôme de bachelor en gestion d'entreprise, droit des affaires, informatique de gestion ou dans une discipline comparable.
- Une première expérience dans la manipulation des données ainsi que dans l'analyse de données constitue un avantage.
- Tu es une personne orientée vers le travail en équipe, faisant preuve d'initiative et dotée d'excellentes compétences en communication.
- Vous disposez de solides capacités analytiques et conceptuelles, d’une méthode de travail structurée et autonome ainsi que de très bonnes connaissances de MS Office, notamment d’Excel et de PowerPoint.
- Très bonne maîtrise de l’allemand et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Contact

Pour toute question, consulte notre page FAQ ou contacte Janine Reichling au numéro +41 58 399 42 99.

Pour ce poste, nous ne considérons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité nous tient à cœur, c’est pourquoi nous accueillons les candidatures quels que soient les parcours personnels.

jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Senior Test Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich |  Bis zu 40 % Homeoffice möglich | Referenz 8324

Du arbeitest gerne in einem dynamischen Team und agilen Umfeld

und Testautomatisierung ist deine Stärke? Dann werde Senior Test Engineer bei Terravis und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir intelligente, skalierbare Lösungen entwickeln.

Als führende digitale Plattform setzt Terravis Massstäbe in der domänenübergreifenden digitalen Abwicklung von Grundstückgeschäften und vernetzt Finanzindustrie, Notariats- und Grundbuchwesen für sichere, effiziente und rechtskonforme Immobilienprozesse und Grundstücktranskationen. Als Teil unseres Teams Business Engineering & Testing arbeitest du eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, um das Angebot rund um Terravis weiterzuentwickeln und zu optimieren. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung und DevOps zusammen und gibst dein Testing-Know-how im Team weiter.

• Durchführung von manuellen Tests auf Basis der Internen-Anforderungen / Kundenanforderungen, Dokumentation und Analyse der Testergebnisse.

• Erstellung von aussagekräftigen Jira-Tickets als Grundlage für das Bugfixing bei der Entwicklung und gleichzeitig als Entscheidungshilfe für das Releasemanagement.

• Ausführung und Dokumentation automatisierter Tests.

• Unterstützung beim Refactoring der bestehenden Testautomaten und der Entwicklung einer skalierbaren Testautomatisierungslösung.

Das bringst du mit

• Testarchitektur – Du kennst den Aufbau wartbarer und konfigurierbaren Testautomatisierungs-Frameworks aus der Praxis. Testdaten beschaffst und pflegst du eigenständig über Schnittstellen wie SQL-Server oder Excel und schaffst damit die Grundlage für reproduzierbares manuelles wie automatisiertes Testen.

• Fehleranalyse und Reporting – Fähigkeit, Fehlerursachen im Testlauf (inkl. Logs, Screenshots, Reports) zu identifizieren und zu beheben. Erstellen von aussagekräftigen Tickets für Bugs, welche mit den funktionalen Tests im Testsubjekt gefunden werden.

• Sicherer Umgang mit Testautomationen – Sicherer Umgang mit Selenium-Webdriver und Cucumber. Du schreibst wartbare Test-Szenarien und implementierst die dazugehörigen Step-Definitionen browserübergreifend (Chrome, Edge) gegen unsere Webapplikation. Fundierte Erfahrung in Java und Maven setzen wir voraus. JavaScript-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Frameworks und Tools – Erfahrung mit Jetbrains IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, JDBC, Jakarta (wsimport), Smartbear SOAP-UI, GitLab und JIRA.

• Sprachen - Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Zurigo | Possibilità di lavorare da casa fino al 40 % | Riferimento 8324

Ti piace lavorare in un team dinamico e in un ambiente agile

e l'automazione dei test è il tuo punto di forza? Allora diventa Senior Test Engineer presso Terravis e contribuisci attivamente a definire come sviluppiamo soluzioni intelligenti e scalabili.

In qualità di piattaforma digitale leader, Terravis stabilisce nuovi standard nella gestione digitale intersettoriale delle transazioni immobiliari e collega il settore finanziario, il notariato e i registri fondiari per processi immobiliari e transazioni fondiarie sicuri, efficienti e conformi alla legge. Come parte del nostro team Business Engineering & Testing, collabori a stretto contatto con stakeholder interni ed esterni per sviluppare e ottimizzare ulteriormente l'offerta di Terravis. Saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura.

Queste sono le tue mansioni

- Collabori a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo e DevOps e condividi con il team il tuo know-how in materia di testing.
- Esecuzione di test manuali sulla base dei requisiti interni / dei requisiti dei clienti, documentazione e analisi dei risultati dei test.
- Creazione di ticket Jira significativi come base per la correzione dei bug da parte dello sviluppo e, al contempo, come ausilio decisionale per la gestione delle release.
- Esecuzione e documentazione di test automatizzati.
- Supporto al refactoring degli strumenti di test esistenti e allo sviluppo di una soluzione scalabile per l'automazione dei test.

Il tuo profilo

- Architettura dei test – Conosci per esperienza pratica la struttura di framework di automazione dei test manutenibili e configurabili. Reperisci e mantieni autonomamente i dati di test tramite interfacce come SQL-Server o Excel, creando così le basi per test manuali e automatizzati riproducibili.
- Analisi degli errori e reporting – Capacità di identificare e risolvere le cause degli errori durante l'esecuzione dei test (inclusi log, screenshot, report). Creazione di ticket significativi per i bug rilevati con i test funzionali sul sistema sottoposto a test.
- Padronanza dell'automazione dei test – Padronanza di Selenium-Webdriver e Cucumber. Scrivi scenari di test manutenibili e implementi le relative definizioni degli step su più browser (Chrome, Edge) per la nostra applicazione web. Diamo per scontata una solida esperienza in Java e Maven. La conoscenza di JavaScript costituisce un vantaggio.
- Framework e strumenti – Esperienza con Jetbrains IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucumber, JDBC, Jakarta (wsimport), Smartbear SOAP-UI, GitLab e JIRA.
- Lingue - Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, sia nella forma scritta sia in quella parlata.

Contatti

Per qualsiasi domanda, visita la nostra pagina delle FAQ oppure contatta Beata Czyzewska ai numeri +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questa posizione prendiamo in considerazione esclusivamente candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, pertanto saremo lieti di ricevere candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.

Description

SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What distinguishes us is driving us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mix of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of the financial markets with us.

Senior Test Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich, Up to 40% HomeOffice possible, Reference 8324

You like working in a dynamic team and a agile environment

and test automation is your strength? Then become Senior Test Engineer at Terravis and actively shape how we develop smart, scalable solutions.

As a leading digital platform, Terravis sets standards in the domain-wide digital processing of property business and connects the financial industry, notarial and land accounting for secure, efficient and legally compliant property processes and property transactions. As part of our Business Engineering & Testing team, you work closely with internal and external stakeholders to further develop and optimize the range of services around Terravis. We look forward to receiving your application documents.

These are your tasks

- You work closely with development and DevOps and pass on your expertise in the team in the field of development.
- Conduct manual tests based on internal requirements / customer requirements, documentation and analysis of test results.
- Creation of meaningful Jira tickets as the basis for bugfixing during development and at the same time as a decision-making aid for release management.
- Execution and documentation of automated tests.
- Support for re-factoring of existing test machines and the development of a scalable test automation solution.

You bring this with you

- Test architecture – You know how to build up repairable and configurable test automation frameworks from practice. You can process and process test data independently via interfaces such as SQL servers or Excel and thus create the basis for reproducible manual and automated testing.
- Error Analysis and Reporting – Ability to identify and fix bugs in the test run (including logs, screenshots, and reports). Create meaningful tickets for bugs that are found with the functional tests in the test subject.
- Safe handling of test automations – Safe handling of selenium webdriver and cucumber. You write time-proven test scenarios and implement the corresponding step definitions across browsers (Chrome, Edge) against our web application. We require a well-founded experience in Java and Maven. JavaScript knowledge is an advantage.
- Frameworks and Tools – Experience with Jetbrains IntelliJ IDE, JUnit, Selenium, Cucbridge, JDBC, jabsimport, smart bear SOAP-UI, GitLab and JIRA.
- Languages - Very good German and English language skills.

Contact

If you have any questions, please visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +3 91 333 51 49.

For this vacancy we take into account only direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we are happy about applications regardless of the personal background.

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Workplace Support Specialist

Zurich |  100 | Reference 7978

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site. Please note that the role is 100% ofiice-based.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts

• solid understanding of Active Directory / Azure AD and basic Intune tasks

• basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fundamentals) for onsite troubleshooting

• experience working with ticketing and asset processes, SLA oriented mindset

• high service orientation, reliability, structured working style, and clear communication

• German fluent (spoken and written); good English for documentation and support interaction

• ITIL Foundation or comparable certification

• experience in large enterprise environments

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• English certification (e.g. Cambridge B2 / C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

- fornire supporto onsite di 2° livello (e supporto di riserva per il 1° livello quando richiesto) per i client Windows 11 e i servizi standard del workplace

- installare, sostituire e risolvere i problemi dei dispositivi degli utenti finali (laptop, monitor, docking station, periferiche)
- fornire supporto per Microsoft 365 e per la gestione di utenti e accessi in Active Directory / Azure AD
- gestire e supportare stampanti, sale riunioni e tecnologie di collaborazione (Teams Rooms, videoconferenze)
- supportare la gestione degli endpoint (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) per la registrazione dei dispositivi, i controlli di conformità e l'assegnazione del software
- contribuire alla standardizzazione del workplace e alla gestione del ciclo di vita (dispositivi, accessori, sale riunioni)
- supportare rollout, progetti pilota e cicli di rinnovo in collaborazione con i team di engineering centrali
- garantire una documentazione accurata di soluzioni, processi e guide operative
- collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di engineering di 3° livello, i fornitori di servizi e gli stakeholder interni
- supportare progetti IT più piccoli relativi al workplace e iniziative di miglioramento continuo
- fungere da referente affidabile in sede per le iniziative e gli standard centrali

Cosa porti con te

- 2–4+ anni di esperienza nel supporto IT in sede o nell'IT service desk (livello 1/2) in ambienti aziendali
- solide competenze pratiche in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)
- esperienza pratica nel supporto hardware e nei rollout strutturati
- solida conoscenza di Active Directory / Azure AD e delle attività di base in Intune
- conoscenze di base del networking (fondamenti di TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN) per la risoluzione dei problemi in loco
- esperienza nella gestione dei processi di ticketing e degli asset, mentalità orientata agli SLA
- spiccato orientamento al servizio, affidabilità, metodo di lavoro strutturato e comunicazione chiara
- Tedesco fluente (parlato e scritto); buon inglese per la documentazione e le interazioni di supporto
- Certificazione ITIL Foundation o equivalente
- esperienza in grandi ambienti aziendali
- know-how su Microsoft Teams Rooms e sulla tecnologia per sale riunioni
- Certificazione di inglese (ad es. Cambridge B2 / C1)

Contatti

Per qualsiasi domanda, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al .

Per questa posizione accettiamo solo candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, desideriamo ricevere candidature indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

- assurer le support de la gestion des terminaux (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) pour l'enrôlement des appareils, les contrôles de conformité et l'attribution des logiciels
- contribuer à la standardisation de l'environnement de travail et à la gestion du cycle de vie (appareils, accessoires, salles de réunion)

- travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’ingénierie de niveau 3, les prestataires de services et les parties prenantes internes

- agir en tant qu’interlocuteur fiable sur site pour les initiatives et les normes centrales

- connaissances de base en réseau (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, notions fondamentales de VLAN) pour le dépannage sur site

jobs.title: Technical Integration Manager (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Technical Integration Manager (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  80-100% (Working from home up 40%) | Reference 8294

Do you want to work at the intersection of banking services, technology and customer integration? Are you motivated to help banks, partners and internal teams bring secure and stable services into production? Then our SIX BBS team wants to hear from you. We are responsible for onboarding, technical integration and operational support for services such as debiX API, eBill, LSV, Debit and bLink. In this role, you will work closely with banks, customers, software partners, vendors and internal teams across Product, IT, Security, Compliance and Operations. Your focus will be on technical integrations, customer onboarding, testing, go-live preparation, second-level support and a structured handover into regular operations. This is a central interface role between customers, technology and operations, rather than a pure project management, product owner or software engineering role.

What You Will Do

• Coordinate technical integration projects for debiX API and other BBS services such as eBill, Debit and ATM, from initial alignment through go-live and handover to operations.

• Act as the central contact for banks, customers, software partners, vendors, IT partners and internal teams during onboarding, testing, acceptance and production preparation.

• Clarify business, technical and operational requirements for API-based integrations, customer connections, certificates, environments and support processes.

• Support test preparation and execution, issue analysis, customer acceptance, go-live activities, hypercare and the transition into regular operations.

• Provide second-level support for customer requests, interface topics, certificates, integration issues and production-related incidents.

What You Bring

• Experience in technical customer integration, API integration, partner onboarding, service integration or technical project coordination, ideally in banking, payments or another regulated environment.

• Good understanding of REST APIs, XML, JSON, authentication, certificates, mutual TLS, OAuth or comparable security and interface topics.

• Experience with testing, acceptance, go-live preparation, incident handling, second-level support, service management and operational handover.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearly to banks, customers, business teams, IT partners and vendors.

• Structured, pragmatic and reliable working style with a strong customer focus; fluent German and English, French or Italian is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Ingegnere di software senior - Dati

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa 40% possibile | Riferimento 8303

Vuoi costruire sistemi affidabili e ad alta intensità di dati che alimentano i servizi di indice finanziario? Il nostro team di Indice distribuito si trova a Zurigo e in India, dove i dati, l'ingegneria e i mercati finanziari si fondono.

In qualità di Senior Software Engineer focalizzato sui dati, svilupperai pipeline e servizi basati su Python e acquisirai la proprietà end-to-end dei dati di mercato, riferimento, configurazione e indice. Lavorando con i team di ingegneria, prodotto, architettura, QA e SRE, garantirai un'elaborazione accurata, tracciabile e resiliente dall'ingestione alla distribuzione.

Cosa farai

• Progettazione, costruzione e gestione di datadotti basati su Python e servizi per i dati di mercato, riferimento e indice attraverso l'elaborazione batch e in tempo reale.

• Possedere il ciclo di vita dei dati dall'ingestione e dalla validazione alla trasformazione, orchestrazione, riconciliazione, ripetizione e recupero.

• Fornire soluzioni modulari, testabili, manutenbili e osservabili con test automatizzati e condutture di distribuzione affidabili.

• Costruire sistemi distribuiti scalabili e resilienti che gestiscono grandi volumi, dati, prestazioni e supporto operativo in ritardo o duplicati.

• Collabora con i team di prodotto, dominio, architettura, QA e SRE per migliorare le piattaforme di dati, gli standard di ingegneria e le pratiche di sviluppo moderne.

Che cosa porta

• Forte esperienza di Python nello sviluppo, nella sperimentazione, nella distribuzione e nella gestione di data pipeline e servizi di livello di produzione; Java è un vantaggio.

• Conoscenza solida dell'ingegneria dei dati, compresi i modelli di estrazione-trasforma-carico, modellazione dei dati, trasformazione, lineage, qualità dei dati, orchestrazione e elaborazione batch e in tempo reale.

• Esperienza con sistemi distribuiti e intensivi di dati, tra cui scalabilità, resilienza, performance, osservabilità, idempotency, riconciliazione e recupero.

• Forti pratiche di ingegneria del software, tra cui progettazione modulare, test automatizzati, controllo della versione, integrazione continua e documentazione tecnica.

• L'esperienza con Apache Airflow o Metaflow e finanziaria-mercato, time-series o dati indice è un vantaggio; esperienza di grado o equivalente, inglese fluente e tedesco come un plus.

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer - Data

Zurich | Working from home 40% possible | Reference 8303

Do you want to build reliable, data-intensive systems that power financial index services? Our distributed Index team is based in Zurich and India, where data, engineering, and financial markets come together.

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on data, you will develop Python-based pipelines and services and take end-to-end ownership of market, reference, configuration, and index data. Working with engineering, product, architecture, QA, and SRE teams, you will ensure accurate, traceable, and resilient processing from ingestion to distribution.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and operate Python-based data pipelines and services for market, reference, and index data across batch and real-time processing.

• Own the data lifecycle from ingestion and validation to transformation, orchestration, reconciliation, replay, and recovery.

• Deliver modular, testable, maintainable, and observable solutions with automated testing and reliable deployment pipelines.

• Build scalable and resilient distributed systems that handle large volumes, late or duplicate data, performance, and operational support.

• Collaborate with product, domain, architecture, QA, and SRE teams to improve data platforms, engineering standards, and modern development practices.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on Python experience developing, testing, deploying, and operating production-grade data pipelines and services; Java is an advantage.

• Solid knowledge of data engineering, including extract-transform-load patterns, data modelling, transformation, lineage, data quality, orchestration, and batch and real-time processing.

• Experience with distributed, data-intensive systems, including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, idempotency, reconciliation, and recovery.

• Strong software engineering practices, including modular design, automated testing, version control, continuous integration, and technical documentation.

• Experience with Apache Airflow or Metaflow and financial-market, time-series, or index data is an advantage; relevant degree or equivalent experience, fluent English, and German as a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Senior Software Engineer - Daten

Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause aus 40% möglich | Referenz 8303

Möchten Sie zuverlässige, datenintensive Systeme bauen, die Finanzindex-Services betreiben? Unser verteiltes Index-Team hat seinen Sitz in Zürich und Indien, wo Daten, Engineering und Finanzmärkte zusammenkommen.

Als Senior Software Engineer, der sich auf Daten konzentriert, entwickeln Sie Python-basierte Pipelines und Dienste und übernehmen das End-to-End-Eigentum für Markt-, Referenz-, Konfigurations- und Indexdaten. In Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, Produkt-, Architektur-, QA- und SRE-Teams sorgen Sie für eine genaue, rückverfolgbare und belastbare Verarbeitung von der Einnahme bis zur Verteilung.

Was Sie tun werden

• Entwerfen, erstellen und betreiben Sie Python-basierte Datenpipelines und Dienste für Markt-, Referenz- und Indexdaten über Batch- und Echtzeitverarbeitung.

• Besitzen Sie den Datenlebenszyklus von der Aufnahme und Validierung bis hin zur Transformation, Orchestrierung, Abstimmung, Wiedergabe und Wiederherstellung.

• Liefern Sie modulare, testbare, wartbare und beobachtbare Lösungen mit automatisierten Tests und zuverlässigen Bereitstellungspipelines.

• Erstellen Sie skalierbare und belastbare verteilte Systeme, die große Mengen, späte oder doppelte Daten, Leistung und Betriebsunterstützung verarbeiten.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Produkt-, Domänen-, Architektur-, QA- und SRE-Teams zusammen, um Datenplattformen, Engineering-Standards und moderne Entwicklungspraktiken zu verbessern.

Was du mitbringst

• Starke praktische Python-Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, dem Testen, der Bereitstellung und dem Betrieb von Datenpipelines und -diensten in Produktionsqualität; Java ist ein Vorteil.

• Solides Wissen über Data Engineering, einschließlich Extrakt-Transformation-Lademuster, Datenmodellierung, Transformation, Abstammung, Datenqualität, Orchestrierung sowie Batch- und Echtzeitverarbeitung.

• Erfahrung mit verteilten, datenintensiven Systemen, einschließlich Skalierbarkeit, Widerstandsfähigkeit, Leistung, Beobachtbarkeit, Idempotenz, Abgleich und Wiederherstellung.

• Starke Software-Engineering-Praktiken, einschließlich modularem Design, automatisiertem Testen, Versionskontrolle, kontinuierlicher Integration und technischer Dokumentation.

• Erfahrung mit Apache Airflow oder Metaflow und Finanzmarkt-, Zeitreihen- oder Indexdaten ist ein Vorteil; relevanter Abschluss oder gleichwertige Erfahrung, fließend Englisch und Deutsch als Plus.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Beata Czyzewska unter +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre racines locales et pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Ingénieur logiciel senior - Données

Zurich: travail à domicile 40% possible

Voulez-vous construire des systèmes fiables et à forte intensité de données qui alimentent les services d'indice financier? Notre équipe d'index distribuée est basée à Zurich et en Inde, où les données, l'ingénierie et les marchés financiers se réunissent.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel principal axé sur les données, vous développerez des pipelines et des services basés sur Python et prendrez la propriété de bout en bout des données de marché, de référence, de configuration et d'index. En travaillant avec des équipes d'ingénierie, de produits, d'architecture, d'AQ et de SRE, vous assurerez un traitement précis, traçable et résistant de l'ingestion à la distribution.

Ce que vous ferez

• Concevoir, construire et exploiter des pipelines et des services de données basés sur le Python pour les données de marché, de référence et d'index pour le traitement par lots et en temps réel.

• Posséder le cycle de vie des données de l'ingestion et de la validation à la transformation, l'orchestration, la réconciliation, le replay et la récupération.

• Fournir des solutions modulaires, testables, durables et observables avec des pipelines d'essais automatisés et de déploiement fiables.

• Construisez des systèmes répartis évolutifs et résilients qui gèrent de grands volumes, des données tardives ou dupliquées, des performances et un soutien opérationnel.

• Collaborer avec les équipes produit, domaine, architecture, QA et SRE pour améliorer les plateformes de données, les normes d'ingénierie et les pratiques de développement modernes.

Ce que vous apportez

• Forte expérience pratique Python développant, testant, déployant et exploitant des pipelines de données et des services de production ; Java est un avantage.

• Connaissance approfondie de l'ingénierie des données, y compris les modèles de charge de transformation des extraits, la modélisation des données, la transformation, la lignée, la qualité des données, l'orchestration et le traitement par lots et en temps réel.

• Expérience des systèmes distribués à forte intensité de données, y compris l'évolutivité, la résilience, la performance, l'observabilité, l'idempotency, le rapprochement et la récupération.

• De solides pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle, y compris la conception modulaire, les essais automatisés, le contrôle des versions, l'intégration continue et la documentation technique.

• L'expérience avec Apache Airflow ou Metaflow et les données du marché financier, des séries chronologiques ou de l'indice est un avantage; diplôme pertinent ou expérience équivalente, l'anglais couramment et l'allemand comme un plus.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Observability Engineer

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7664

The Senior Observability Engineer is a hands-on role focused on building and delivering observability and AIOps as a shared engineering capability and service. You will help establish how observability is designed, implemented, and consumed across teams, leading early onboardings and shaping practical standards, processes, and ways of working.

Working closely with platform, product, and application teams, you will translate requirements into actionable observability solutions, implement and operate core capabilities, and continuously improve how insights, alerting, and automation support reliable services. As a core contributor to the Observability & AIOps Center of Excellence, you will combine deep technical execution with strong ownership of service quality, operational readiness, and capability maturity

What You Will Do

• design, deploy, and operate observability and AIOps capabilities for cloud-native and hybrid environments, supporting reliable, production-grade services

• lead the onboarding of teams and services, defining and applying standards for telemetry instrumentation, collection, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting in real-world systems using OpenTelemetry

• work hands-on with engineering, SRE, and operations teams to gather requirements and translate them into actionable observability and automation solutions

• install, configure, fine-tune, and maintain OpenTelemetry Collectors and telemetry pipelines for applications and platforms

• build and maintain dashboards, alerting, and telemetry flows across distributed tracing, metrics, and logs, leveraging OpenTelemetry to deliver meaningful insights and reduce operational noise

• run and evolve observability services that support modern incident detection, investigation, and operational decision-making

• design, configure, and maintain integrations with event management and ticketing systems for alert routing, incident context, and operational workflows

What You Bring

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in observability, SRE, platform, or reliability engineering, including responsibility for production observability capabilities

• proven experience taking observability capabilities from requirements to production-ready solutions; experience limited to dashboards, queries, or observability backends as a consumer is not sufficient

• practical experience instrumenting applications and infrastructure with OpenTelemetry to generate traces, metrics, and logs

• strong understanding of modern, trace-centric observability practices beyond traditional log-centric monitoring

• experience deploying, configuring, and operating OpenTelemetry Collectors and designing telemetry pipelines is a strong advantage; these will be key hands-on responsibilities in the role

• experience with cloud-native environments, operating Kubernetes-based workloads

• experience with common observability toolchains and backends (e.g.: Elastic, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, etc.) - Elastic Stack experience considered a plus

• scripting or automation skills to support repeatable deployment, configuration, validation, and ongoing operations using technologies such as Helm, Terraform, and Ansible

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Ingegnere di osservazione senior

Zurigo | Fino al 40% lavorando da casa possibile | Riferimento 7664

L'Ingegnere per l'Osservabilità Senior è un ruolo pratico incentrato sulla costruzione e sulla fornitura di osservabilità e AIOps come capacità e servizio di ingegneria condivisa. Aiuterai a stabilire come l'osservabilità è progettata, implementata e consumata in team, conducendo i primi onboard e modellando standard pratici, processi e modi di lavoro.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di piattaforma, prodotto e applicazioni, tradurrai i requisiti in soluzioni di osservabilità attuabili, implementare e gestire le funzionalità di base e migliorare continuamente come intuizioni, avvisi e automazione supportano servizi affidabili. Come contributore fondamentale al Centro di Eccellenza per l'Osservabilità e l'AIOps, unirete l'esecuzione tecnica profonda con una forte proprietà della qualità del servizio, della disponibilità operativa e della maturità di capacità

Cosa farai

• progettazione, distribuzione e gestione delle capacità di osservazione e AIOps per ambienti cloud-nativi e ibridi, supportando servizi affidabili e di qualità produttiva

• guidare l'imbarco di team e servizi, definendo e applicando gli standard per la strumentazione della telemetria, la raccolta, SLIs, SLOs e l'avviso in sistemi reali utilizzando OpenTelemetry

• lavorare hands-on con team di ingegneria, SRE e operazioni per raccogliere i requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni di osservazione e automazione attuabili

• installare, configurare, ottimizzare e mantenere OpenTelemetry Collectors e tubazioni di telemetria per applicazioni e piattaforme

• costruire e mantenere cruscotti, avvisi e flussi di telemetria attraverso tracciamento distribuito, metriche e registri, sfruttando OpenTelemetry per fornire informazioni significative e ridurre il rumore operativo

• eseguire ed evolvere servizi di osservabilità che supportano il rilevamento degli incidenti moderni, l'indagine e il processo decisionale operativo

• progettazione, configurazione e mantenimento delle integrazioni con i sistemi di gestione degli eventi e di biglietteria per il routing degli avvisi, il contesto degli incidenti e i flussi di lavoro operativi

Che cosa porta

• 8+ anni di esperienza pratica nell'osservabilità, SRE, piattaforma o ingegneria dell'affidabilità, compresa la responsabilità delle capacità di osservanza della produzione

• esperienza comprovata prendendo capacità di osservanza da requisiti a soluzioni pronte alla produzione; esperienza limitata a cruscotti, query o backend di osservabilità come un consumatore non è sufficiente

• pratica esperienza strumentazione applicazioni e infrastrutture con OpenTelemetry per generare tracce, metriche e registri

• forte comprensione delle pratiche di osservabilità moderne, traccia-centriche oltre il monitoraggio tradizionale log-centric

• esperienza di distribuzione, configurazione e funzionamento OpenTelemetry Collectors e progettazione di tubazioni di telemetria è un forte vantaggio; questi saranno responsabilità chiave hands-on nel ruolo

• esperienza con ambienti cloud-native, carichi di lavoro basati su Kubernetes

• esperienza con portautensili e backend osservabili comuni (ad esempio: Elastico, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, ecc) - Esperienza elastica Stack considerata un plus

• capacità di scrittura o automazione per supportare le operazioni ripetibili di distribuzione, configurazione, convalida e in corso utilizzando tecnologie come Helm, Terraform e Ansible

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Zurich jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible

L'Ingénieur principal d'observation joue un rôle pratique axé sur la création et la prestation d'observations et d'opérations d'intelligence artificielle en tant que capacité et service d'ingénierie partagés. Vous aiderez à déterminer comment l'observabilité est conçue, mise en œuvre et consommée dans l'ensemble des équipes, à diriger les premières embarquements et à élaborer des normes, des processus et des méthodes de travail pratiques.

En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de plate-forme, de produit et d'application, vous transformerez les exigences en solutions d'observation réalisables, mettre en œuvre et exploiter des capacités de base, et améliorerez continuellement la façon dont les informations, l'alerte et l'automatisation soutiennent des services fiables. En tant que contributeur principal au Centre d'excellence Observability & AIOps, vous combinerez une exécution technique profonde et une forte appropriation de la qualité du service, de la disponibilité opérationnelle et de la maturité des capacités

Ce que vous ferez

• concevoir, déployer et exploiter des capacités d'observation et d'IAOps pour des environnements cloud-natifs et hybrides, en supportant des services de qualité de production fiables

• diriger l'embarquement des équipes et des services, définir et appliquer des normes pour l'instrumentation de la télémétrie, la collecte, les SLI, les SLO et l'alerte dans les systèmes du monde réel en utilisant OpenTelemetry

• travailler avec des équipes d'ingénierie, de SRE et d'opérations pour rassembler les exigences et les traduire en solutions actionnables d'observation et d'automatisation

• installer, configurer, affiner et entretenir OpenTelemetry Collectionneurs et pipelines de télémétrie pour applications et plateformes

• construire et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des alertes et des flux de télémétrie à travers le traçage distribué, les mesures et les journaux, en tirant parti d'OpenTelemetry pour fournir des informations utiles et réduire le bruit opérationnel

• gérer et développer des services d'observation qui appuient la détection des incidents, les enquêtes et la prise de décisions opérationnelles modernes

• concevoir, configurer et maintenir les intégrations avec les systèmes de gestion des événements et de billetterie pour le routage des alertes, le contexte des incidents et les flux de travail opérationnels

Ce que vous apportez

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience pratique en ingénierie de l'observation, du SRE, de la plate-forme ou de la fiabilité, y compris la responsabilité des capacités d'observation de la production

• expérience éprouvée en prenant des capacités d'observation des exigences aux solutions prêtes à la production; expérience limitée aux tableaux de bord, aux requêtes ou aux moteurs d'observation en tant que consommateur ne suffit pas

• expérience pratique instrumentant les applications et l'infrastructure avec OpenTelemetry pour générer des traces, des métriques et des journaux

• une bonne compréhension des pratiques modernes d'observation centrées sur les traces au-delà de la surveillance traditionnelle centrée sur les logarithmes;

• expérience du déploiement, de la configuration et de l'exploitation OpenTelemetry Les collecteurs et la conception de pipelines de télémétrie constituent un avantage important; il s'agira là de responsabilités clés dans le rôle

• expérience avec les environnements cloud-native, exploitation des charges de travail basées sur Kubernetes

• expérience avec des chaînes d'outils et des moteurs d'observation communs (ex.: Elastic, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, etc.)

• compétences de script ou d'automatisation pour soutenir le déploiement répétable, la configuration, la validation et les opérations en cours utilisant des technologies telles que Helm, Terraform et Ansible

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

As Senior Sales & Account Manager Banking Romandie, you will further develop existing customer relationships, tap into new business opportunities and successfully position our solutions in the areas of Cards, ATM, TWINT, Fraud & Dispute and Banking Services in the market. - several years of experience in sales, business development or account management in the financial services environment, with in-depth knowledge of the Swiss banking market

jobs.title: AI Software Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Software Architect

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8259

Shape and execute the AI SDLC at SIX · reports to Head of Software Engineering Practices

Agentic AI is changing how software gets built — and at SIX, it will touch the work of more than thousand engineers. As AI Software Architect, you will set the technical direction for this shift: designing the reference patterns, tooling, and quality gates that make AI-augmented and agentic development safe and effective in a regulated financial market infrastructure, and driving adoption across teams you don't manage.

What You Will Do

• Translate the AI software engineering strategy into working practice. Design, prototype and harden the reference patterns, tooling and reusable components that make AI SDLC (augmented, agentic) real across SIX.

• Set the deepest technical standards for AI-based development: prompt and agent patterns, code review of AI-generated code, and the quality and security gates that make it safe in a regulated FMI.

• Support and execute the people transformation journey, evolving developer roles, team structures, processes and ways of working to unlock the full potential of AI-augmented software engineering

• Run lighthouse engagements hands-on: understand the process of business-unit software teams, baseline and measure impact on real backlogs, and prove value before scaling.

• Drive adoption across teams you don't manage. Coach senior engineers, win over skeptics, and lead the community of practice across CH, ES, PL and IN.

What You Bring

• 8+ years in software engineering with deep with current hands-on expertise across the entire SDLC. You still design software systems, write and review code, and engineers trust your technical judgment.

• Strong systems and architecture thinking across the end-to-end SDLC, and sound judgment on putting AI into a regulated, business-critical environment

• Hands-on experience with AI harness, LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including building custom workflows when off-the-shelf falls short. Claude Code hands-on experience in production is a plus.

• A track record of driving change through influence, not authority. You've won over skeptical senior engineers and spread practice across teams you didn't manage.

• Excellent stakeholder management, low ego and a teaching instinct — equally credible in a design review with a principal engineer and a risk conversation with security; fluent in English, German a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

AI Software Architetto

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8259

Formare ed eseguire il SDLC AI a SIX · rapporti a capo delle pratiche di ingegneria del software

Agentic AI sta cambiando come il software viene costruito — e a SIX, toccherà il lavoro di più di mille ingegneri. Come AI Software Architect, si imposta la direzione tecnica per questo cambiamento: progettare i modelli di riferimento, strumenti e cancelli di qualità che rendono lo sviluppo AI-augmented e agentic sicuro ed efficace in un'infrastruttura di mercato finanziario regolamentata, e guidare l'adozione in team che non gestisci.

Cosa farai

• Traduci la strategia di ingegneria del software AI nella pratica di lavoro. Progettazione, prototipo e indurimento dei modelli di riferimento, utensili e componenti riutilizzabili che rendono AI SDLC (augmented, agentic) reale attraverso SIX.

• Impostare gli standard tecnici più profondi per lo sviluppo basato su AI: modelli di prompt e agente, la revisione del codice del codice generato dall'IA, e le porte di qualità e sicurezza che lo rendono sicuro in un FMI regolamentato.

• Sostenere ed eseguire il viaggio di trasformazione delle persone, l'evoluzione dei ruoli dello sviluppatore, le strutture del team, i processi e i modi di lavorare per sbloccare il pieno potenziale dell'ingegneria del software aumentata dall'IA

• Eseguire gli impegni del faro hands-on: capire il processo di business-unit software team, baseline e misura l'impatto su backlog reali, e dimostrare il valore prima di scaling.

• Guida l'adozione tra le squadre che non gestisci. Allenatori senior, vincere gli scettici, e guidare la comunità di pratica attraverso CH, ES, PL e IN.

Che cosa porta

• 8+ anni di ingegneria del software con profonda esperienza pratica in tutto il SDLC. Si progetta ancora sistemi software, scrivere e rivedere il codice, e gli ingegneri si fidano del vostro giudizio tecnico.

• Sistemi e architettura forti che pensano attraverso il SDLC end-to-end, e giudizio sonoro sul mettere l'IA in un ambiente regolamentato, business-critical

• Hands-on esperienza con imbracatura AI, API LLM e quadri di agente, tra cui la costruzione di flussi di lavoro personalizzati quando fuori-the-shelf cade breve. Claude Code esperienza pratica nella produzione è un vantaggio.

• Una traccia di cambiamento di guida attraverso l'influenza, non l'autorità. Hai vinto gli ingegneri senior scettici e la pratica di diffusione in squadre che non hai gestito.

• Eccellente gestione degli stakeholder, basso ego e un istinto di insegnamento — altrettanto credibile in una recensione di progettazione con un ingegnere principale e una conversazione di rischio con la sicurezza; fluente in inglese, tedesco un plus.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Per l'ulteriore sviluppo della piattaforma eBill, potenziamo il nostro team di sviluppo agile e cerchiamo una persona con esperienza nell'architettura delle applicazioni e passione per lo sviluppo full-stack con tecnologie Angular e Java. Queste sono le tue mansioni

- Contribuirai attivamente alla trasformazione evolutiva della piattaforma eBill e svilupperai funzionalità di business innovative per una delle principali reti digitali di fatturazione della Svizzera.

- Svilupperai e gestirai applicazioni business-critical con moderne tecnologie Java e web e promuoverai l'eccellenza tecnica attraverso i principi DevOps e le best practice.
- Collaborerai a stretto contatto con Product Management, Architecture ed Engineering, apporterai attivamente la tua esperienza al team e contribuirai a garantire la gestione stabile della piattaforma, inclusa la disponibilità per il servizio di reperibilità.

Cosa porti con te

- Solida esperienza nello sviluppo e nell'architettura di moderne applicazioni web basate su Java, nonché spiccate capacità di pensiero concettuale.
- Esperienza pluriennale con tecnologie come Java, Spring Boot, REST API, SQL, nonché con moderni strumenti per lo sviluppo, la CI/CD e la gestione delle versioni.
- Esperienza con metodologie di lavoro agili, principi DevOps e gestione di applicazioni business-critical.
- Interesse per lo sviluppo software assistito dall'AI e passione per portare nella pratica nuove tecnologie e approcci risolutivi innovativi.
- Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, nonché capacità di discutere temi tecnici in modo comprensibile con diversi stakeholder.

Per questa posizione consideriamo esclusivamente candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, pertanto accogliamo con piacere le candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.

Zurich | 40% home office is possible | Reference 8282

Within the Banking Services division, we develop and operate the eBill and direct debit services used throughout Switzerland. To further develop the eBill platform, we are strengthening our agile development team and looking for someone with experience in application architecture and an enthusiasm for full-stack development using Angular and Java technologies. Together, you will shape a robust, reliable, and high-performance platform for Swiss invoicing and payments.

What you bring

- Solid experience in the development and architecture of modern Java-based web applications, as well as strong conceptual thinking skills.

Contact
